comparison.objective: Use a ruler to place a block with its center 10 cm beyond a taped reference line.
comparison.physical_skill: Measurement from a reference and accurate planar placement.
comparison.success_condition: Full score at no more than 1 cm error, half score at no more than 2 cm, with the block resting on the table.
comparison.reason: Measurement-based placement is mechanically and outcome-wise different from controlled impact fracture and debris recovery.
